description: LTA Bus Stop is a dataset listed in Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg), an open data portal, published or maintained by Land Transport Authority. A symbolic point representation of a pole to indicate the position where buses should stop to pickup or drop off passengers. Coverage: Singapore. The portal files it under the publisher Land Transport Authority. It offers 1 resource(s) in geojson. The portal shows 2026-09-20 as the last metadata change. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sg-dgs-portal.
